title: Flutter Storm

outfit_card.silhouette: A strapless draped bodice with pleated tulle gathers into a flowing A-line skirt, layered with sheer organza panels, voluminous tulle layers, and a soft, flowing train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate silver floral vine tiara adorned with tiny glittering crystals and pearl-tipped branch motifs, paired with a sheer, trailing net veil.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless sweetheart bodice wrapped in metallic silver lace with crystal beadwork, featuring a pleated center drape and detached sheer tulle sleeves with lace cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A multi-layered ballgown skirt with petal-like pleats, gradient organza ruffles, tulle underlayers, and sheer stockings paired with iridescent silver pointed heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent blue butterfly accents, delicate wing-like tulle, and trailing sparkles of frost and starlight scattered around the flowing design.
